cells.question: Q05

passages.quote: The model continues to perform at the early warning threshold level for the Cyber Uplift Level 1 CCL, and has reached the early warning alert threshold for CBRN Uplift Level 1 CCL.

cells.note: The card states that further study is needed for a final assessment of whether the CBRN Uplift Level 1 CCL is reached, and that the cyber, machine learning R&D and instrumental reasoning CCLs are not reached (summary table, PDF pp. 8–9).

cells.question: Q06

passages.quote: Our model security mitigations have already been aligned with RAND SL2, which is the level required for the CBRN Uplift Level 1 CCL per our Frontier Safety Framework.

cells.note: The card ties additional deployment mitigations, based on an internal safety case, and a security level to its CBRN assessment, and says it has deployed mitigations for the cyber alert threshold (PDF p. 8). A stated safeguard is the developer’s account.

cells.question: Q07

passages.quote: the model has enough technical knowledge in certain CBRN scenarios and stages to be considered at early alert threshold.

cells.note: Outcome category: early alert threshold, final CCL assessment pending. Internal open-ended assessments do not cover chemical information risk; the card says its external testers include chemistry.

cells.question: Q08

cells.question: Q05

passages.quote: the Gemini 2.5 Pro model results give us confidence that Gemini 2.5 Flash is unlikely to reach critical capability levels

cells.note: The card states an expectation for this model that rests on another model’s results: Gemini 2.5 Pro Preview was evaluated and reached no critical capability level, and, as Flash is less capable, Flash is unlikely to reach one. It reports no frontier safety evaluation of Flash and no outcome for it in the framework’s own categories. The card also covers Gemini 2.5 Flash Image and Audio, with no separate statement for them.

crossFamily.result: material disagreement, applied: the checker reads partly (blind), because PDF p. 10 gives a proxy-based expectation for Flash and the no-CCL result is Gemini 2.5 Pro Preview’s, with no separate determination for Image or Audio. The pack had read stated, with the reliance in the note (open question 2). The preparer applies the checker’s reading; see item 6 for the admitted Gemini 3 Flash cell.
